# Tests error when templates variable is not found

! muxt generate --use-templates-variable=nonexistent
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

# Also test when one of multiple variables is missing
! muxt generate --use-templates-variable=templates --use-templates-variable=nonexistent
cmpenv stderr want-err-multi.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Error: variable nonexistent not found
-- want-err-multi.txt --
Error: variable nonexistent not found
-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed template.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "template.gohtml"))
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /"}}Hello{{end}}
